description.zh:
待授权License的设备列表，需传入设备对应的**DeviceName**。

您可调用接口[QueryDevice](~~69905~~)，查询指定产品下所有设备的**DeviceName**。
description.en:
The list of devices to which the license will be authorized. You must provide the **DeviceName** of each device.

You can invoke the [QueryDevice](~~69905~~) API to query the **DeviceName** of all devices under a specified product.

description.zh:
待授权License的设备列表，需传入设备对应的**IotId**。

您可调用接口[QueryDevice](~~69905~~)，查询指定产品下所有设备的**IotId**。
description.en:
The list of devices to which the license will be authorized. You must provide the **IotId** of each device.

You can invoke the [QueryDevice](~~69905~~) API to query the **IotId** of all devices under a specified product.

description.zh: 企业版实例的实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。
description.en: The ID of the Enterprise Edition instance. You can view the **ID** of the instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

description.zh: License类型（音视频规格），可取值：**480P**、**720P**。
description.en: The license type that specifies the audio and video specifications. Valid values: **480P** and **720P**.

description.zh:
待授权设备所属产品的**ProductKey**。

您可以在物联网平台控制台或调用接口[QueryProductList](~~69271~~)，查看当前实例下所有产品的信息。
description.en:
The **ProductKey** of the product to which the devices belong.

You can go to the IoT Platform console or call the [QueryProductList](~~69271~~) operation to view the information about all products of the instance.

title.zh: 为指定产品下设备授权License
title.en: Authorize a License for Devices Under a Specified Product

descriptions.zh:
## 使用说明
调用本接口前，请确认完成以下操作：

1. 请购买License。具体内容，请参见[购买方式](~~427935~~)。
2. 为目标设备所属产品授权License。具体操作，请参见[BindLicenseProduct](~~427956~~)或[产品授权](~~427937~~)。


## QPS限制

单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为10。
> RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## How-To

Before invoking this API, confirm that you have completed the following operations:

1. Purchase a license. For more information, see [Purchase Methods](~~427935~~).
2. Authorize the license for the product to which the target devices belong. For more information, see [BindLicenseProduct](~~427956~~) or [Product Authorization](~~427937~~).


## Queries Per Second (QPS) Limit

The maximum queries per second (QPS) limit for this API is 10 per Alibaba Cloud account.  
> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot bind-license-device --iot-instance-id iot-e3000 --license-code 720P --product-key a2YwD23000 --iot-id-list Q7uOhVRdZRRlDnTLv000000100 --device-name-list test --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iot BindLicenseDevice --region cn-hangzhou --LicenseCode 720P --IotInstanceId 'iot-e3000' --DeviceNameList.1 test --IotIdList.1 Q7uOhVRdZRRlDnTLv000000100 --ProductKey a2YwD23000
